catalysts.name: Albemarle Corporation
catalysts.what: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral on 14 Oct (analyst John Roberts) and set a $130 price target (implies roughly 36% upside from this run's FMP price), citing accelerating battery energy-storage demand tightening lithium market conditions; Mizuho also raised its Albemarle adjusted-EBITDA estimates to $3.2B (2027) and $2.9B (2028) on firmer Benchmark Minerals lithium-carbonate price forecasts ($22,500/t 2027, $19,500/t 2028). Albemarle reports Q3 2026 results 4 Nov.

catalysts.name: Biogen Inc.
catalysts.what: JPMorgan upgraded Biogen to Overweight from Neutral on 12 Oct and raised its price target to $300 from $210 (target horizon Dec 2027; implies roughly 29% upside from this run's FMP price), citing a stronger 2027 pipeline catalyst lineup — felzartamab in antibody-mediated rejection (a market JPMorgan sizes above $2B), litifilimab in cutaneous lupus, and a possible read-through to Leqembi from Lilly's TRAILBLAZER-ALZ-3 Alzheimer's trial. UBS also raised its target the same week, to $270 from $240, but that figure differs from JPMorgan's by more than 5% so only the JPMorgan target is cited. Biogen reports Q3 2026 results 28 Oct.

catalysts.name: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated
catalysts.what: UnitedHealth's Q3 2026 report (13 Oct) showed adjusted EPS of $4.69 against a roughly $4.10-4.14 pre-report consensus, and the company raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to at least $20.50, up from the $19.50–$20.00 range it set in July (reported GAAP EPS was $4.56; the adjusted medical-care ratio improved 150bp to 88.4%, aided by about $610M of favorable reserve development, so part of the beat is not repeatable). Membership fell y/y (50.1M to 48.3M), a caveat on the quarter's quality.
